nextRepairDecision.name: DATA ACQUISITION REPAIR JUSTIFIED
nextRepairDecision.reason: The only shared generic residual affects two strict records and occurs between already-captured evidence and ICP-ready persisted facts. It requires no new provider and can be bounded to explicit provenance-linked geography and primary-business extraction. The CommercialRole residuals do not justify weakening safe abstention, and the identity failure is independent and unsafe to solve by guessing.
nextRepairDecision.singleProposedRepair: Repair the existing evidence-to-ICP extraction, admission, and persistence handoff for explicit provenance-bound geography and primary-business facts; do not add providers or change role/WHO policy.

holdoutReadiness.reason: CommercialRole safety is strong, but known evidence-to-ICP handoff and domain-identity defects still make WHO and identity coverage untrustworthy. Repair and validate those bounded defects before a 10–20 company unseen cohort.
